sections.title: OVERNIGHT MAP
sections.content:
- US tape flipped decisively risk-on: mega-cap tech, semis and industrial electrification led, while defensives lagged.
- The move was broad enough to matter, but still growth-led: useful for your AI book, less useful for ballast.
- Anchors: Nasdaq +2.13%, S&P 500 +1.48%, Dow +1.32%, VIX -0.81%, gold +1.45%, oil -5.18%.

sections.title: US CLOSE MOVERS
sections.content:
- ETN +5.55% — strongest confirmed portfolio mover; industrial/AI power trade caught the risk-on bid.
- MSFT +4.93% — mega-cap tech leadership returned; one of the cleanest quality-AI exposures in the book.
- DXYZ +3.98%, TSLA +3.49%, NVDA +2.93% — speculative/growth appetite improved, but these are not all equal-quality moves.
- AAPL -1.78% — the main US laggard; weak relative to the Nasdaq surge.
- GDS ADR -0.12%, GLD +0.05%, XLU +0.02% — ballast/China ADR lagged the growth rebound.

sections.title: HK LIVE MOVERS
sections.content:
- HK is pre-open: Yahoo HK regular-market timestamps still point to the prior completed session, so treat these as last-session moves, not live prints.
- BABA HK / 9988 +7.01% — standout HK holding; China-tech rerating pressure remains the key watch.
- GDS HK / 9698 +3.22%, CGN / 1816 +2.77% — supportive breadth across higher-beta China data-center and defensive policy exposure.
- Tracker Fund / 2800 +0.15%, Hang Seng +0.10% — broad HK beta lagged single-name China tech.

sections.title: MARKET NEWS
sections.content:
- Barron’s/WSJ framed Monday’s US rally as a Mag 7 and semiconductor rebound, with Microsoft and chip names driving the Nasdaq higher.
- Oil fell sharply while gold rose, so the tape was not pure “everything risk-on”; equity leadership was more about tech/earnings confidence than a clean macro all-clear.

sections.title: ACTION BOARD
sections.content:
- Opportunity: Respect the MSFT/NVDA/ETN leadership signal, but use pullbacks rather than chasing a one-day relief squeeze.
- Risk: AAPL’s weakness against a +2% Nasdaq is the warning flag — broad index strength can hide single-name deterioration.
- Research: Recheck whether HK China-tech strength is now policy/earnings-backed or still mostly rerating momentum before adding BABA/GDS exposure.
